conventions: bpp = Mbps*1e6/(W*H*fps) of the recorded file resolution; fixed = codecs whose bitrate does not scale with resolution/fps choice

cameras.name: SIGMA fp
cameras.notes: Data from Sigma SIGMA fp User's Manual FW Ver.5.0 (bit rate table) and Sigma spec page. Internal: CinemaDNG 8/10/12-bit (image sequence .DNG + .WAV) and MOV H.264 ALL-I/GOP, UHD 3840x2160 up to 29.97p and FHD 1920x1080 up to 119.88p (UHD max 29.97p; no internal DCI 4K). Continuous recording up to 2 h. CinemaDNG UHD 10/12-bit and UHD 8-bit 29.97p need a USB-C portable SSD. Same recording table as fp L. External only (not internal, not included as codecs): HDMI 4:2:2 8-bit, and 12-bit RAW over HDMI recorded as ProRes RAW on Atomos Ninja V / Ninja V+ / Shogun CONNECT or as Blackmagic RAW on Blackmagic Video Assist 12G; DCI 4K 4096x2160 24p is RAW-output-only. Sigma publishes no data rates for these external formats (they depend on the recorder). Audio LPCM 2ch 48 kHz/16-bit.

codecs.name: CinemaDNG 12-bit
codecs.ref: Sigma SIGMA fp User's Manual (FW Ver.5.0), 'BIT RATE AND COMPATIBLE MEDIA' table, CinemaDNG 12-bit: published Mbps per resolution/fps (all values in rates). Top-level bpp from UHD 3840x2160 23.98p = 2400 Mbps; bpp = Mbps*1e6/(W*H*fps). Published figures imply ~12-12.5 bits/pixel (uncompressed DNG frame sequence + overhead). Media: UHD: SSD only; FHD up to 59.94p on SD UHS-II, 100p SSD only. Max: UHD 29.97p; FHD 100p.

cameras.name: SIGMA fp L
cameras.notes: Data from Sigma SIGMA fp L User's Manual FW Ver.3.0 (bit rate table) and Sigma spec page. Internal: CinemaDNG 8/10/12-bit (image sequence .DNG + .WAV) and MOV H.264 ALL-I/GOP, UHD 3840x2160 up to 29.97p and FHD 1920x1080 up to 119.88p (UHD max 29.97p; no internal DCI 4K). Continuous recording up to 2 h. CinemaDNG UHD 10/12-bit and UHD 8-bit 29.97p need a USB-C portable SSD. fp L (61MP sensor) bit-rate table is identical to the fp's; Sigma spec page notes FHD 100p/119.88p apply an automatic x1.67 crop zoom (file still 1920x1080). Crop Zoom changes sensor area, not recorded resolution. External only (not internal, not included as codecs): HDMI 4:2:2 8-bit, and 12-bit RAW over HDMI recorded as ProRes RAW on Atomos Ninja V / Ninja V+ / Shogun CONNECT or as Blackmagic RAW on Blackmagic Video Assist 12G; DCI 4K 4096x2160 24p is RAW-output-only.
